fact: Under the Payment Systems and Services Act, 2019 (Act 987) electronic money issuers and payment service providers must run free complaint procedures, acknowledge within 3 working days and resolve within 5 days (extendable by 15), and a dissatisfied customer can escalate to the Bank of Ghana.
title: Protecting Your Rights In The Digital Space: What every mobile money (MoMo) user in Ghana should know
